description: Validation of the evidence-type rule on the 241-claim purposive-sample extraction that preceded the corpus-wide pass. Inter-model agreement, not accuracy against a hand-read standard.
interpretation: The two revised figures are near-identical, which establishes that the gain came from sharpening the extractor's definitions rather than from aligning the two coders' rules.
reported_in: Paper Section 2.5 (Claim schema) and Appendix A.2 (Coding reliability)
